name: Colima disk trim + weekly dead-container removal (Mac launchd agent)
purpose: every 20 min (launchd com.powos.mac-disk-trim, tools/agents/mac-disk-trim.sh): `colima ssh -- sudo fstrim /mnt/lima-colima` so space freed inside the VM returns to the Mac's data volume (it ran down to 2 GB free with the VM holding freed blocks); once a week `docker rm` of stopped containers dead over 7 days that are not in a compose project and not labelled powos.autosleep (autosleep's stopped containers stay). Never the Docker build cache, images, volumes or files. Replaces the manager's crontab fstrim line
unbounded: macOS has no cgroups; one short bash pass (a colima ssh fstrim capped at 5 min; weekly a docker ps/inspect/rm capped at 2 min) every 20 minutes, niced, low-priority IO
